svg.title: Contour candidate points to final labels - synthetic example
svg.desc: Generated only from synthetic geometry using the stable contour label algorithm. No real terrain or production data.

g.text: From dense candidates to final contour labels
Stable V3.4 core / synthetic contours / adjacent-contour evidence, no DEM
5 labels after direction and density selection
Dashed frame: safe interior. Brown: contours. Amber: candidates. Teal: final labels. Font enlarged for illustration.
